new.st: USGS GNIS archive lists Summit United Brethren Church (historical) here (Church, West Lima quad). Find a Grave lists Booher Cemetery (also known as Summit Cemetery) (id 2538484, 3 memorials) about 63 m from the GNIS church point, which confirms the church site. The church ground and the cemetery are look-only. Only 3 burials are listed, the latest in 1864.
new.t: Look only. Read the stones and the church history; do not dig or detect on church or cemetery ground.

new.n: Marietta (old town site, first county seat of Marshall County)
new.pl: Old Marietta town site, Marshall County (GNIS Marietta and Marietta Post Office, historical)
new.v: Coins, tokens, household items from the old town lots
new.st: Marietta once promised to be the metropolis of central Iowa and was prominent before the railroads, then drifted back until nothing was left; by 1903 the old town site was farm land, and an action to quiet title to about 1,000 acres named 500 defendants, the heirs of old lot owners. Marietta Cemetery lies about 1.7 km south. The cemetery is look-only.
new.t: Farm land now: compare the GNIS point with a 1870s-1900s Marshall County plat and the 1930s air photo for the old street grid, then ask the landowner.
src: USGS GNIS: Marietta and Marietta Post Office (historical)
Rock Island Argus, 16 Sep 1903, p. 1 (Chronicling America)
